line.comment: * Add-Ons 2.2: Mission failure penalty.
* Bait and Rescue missions incur double penalty if the player claimed the ship and is currently flying it. This is a safety, as destroying the PLAYERSHIP results in a game over.
* Police mission incurs double penalty if the player scanned and claimed the culprit.
* Delivery mission incurs double penalty if all stations and the player is currently flying the delivery ship.
* Supply always incurs double penalty.
* -500 reputation and -1 Loyalty per penalty point.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Reputation penalty now scales with game difficulty on Hard and Insane.
* Loyalty Points are removed only if the player still has Loyalty after reputation loss.
* ===== Mission Cleanup =====
* Abort mission
* Don't use Mayhem.MissionEntry.Abort. Must properly remove the mission with Mayhem.Mission.Remove.
* Cleanup
* Add-Ons 2.2: Added extra cleanup for additional missions besides rescue and police.
* Rescue: destroy passengers. JOO the ship if it's not [PLAYERSHIP].
* Police: destroy passenger. Remove the local variable from the culprit.
* Unlike the other ship reward missions, the culprit is not destroyed because it is a real worker.
* Delivery: clear mission state from the delivery ship.
* If a destination station was destroyed, the surviving delivery ship is allowed to remain as consolation.
* Otherwise, remove it unless it is the PLAYERSHIP. If it is the PLAYERSHIP, the increased failure penalty applies.
* Patrol: JOO all spawned Xenon ships.
* Bait: JOO the bait ship if it's not [PLAYERSHIP] and all spawned Kha'ak ships.
* Defense: JOO all spawned Xenon ships.
